appDescription: A field service assistant that tells the next customer about delays and arrivals using the vehicle's navigation ETA, and reorders today's visits.

function.name: NOTIFY_DELAY
function.description: Send a delay notice with the expected arrival window to the next customer on today's visit list.

delayMinutes.description: Expected delay in minutes compared with the promised visit time.

function.name: READ_NEXT_JOB
function.description: Read out the next customer, the expected arrival time and the visit after that.

function.name: CHANGE_TO_PARKING
function.description: Change the navigation destination to the parking entrance that the customer has shared.

entranceName.description: Name of the parking entrance shared by the customer.
